rv.q: This enjoyable entertainment is, quite frankly, a delightful diversion that we all could use right now.
“Dames at Sea” is campy and goofy, but will leave you with a smile on your face and a song in your heart.
Were that sound tuned, this show could be somewhat recommended.
The perfect holiday show is now playing at Citadel Theatre in Lake Forest.
The tap dancing and energy on stage will find you feeling good, smiling and bouncy.
What is amazing about this show is how choreographer/director Gregg Denhardt has fit the action, including the whole chorus line, onto Citadel's tiny stage.

cn.t: Critics praise this tuneful spoof of 1930s musicals as bubbly, toe-tapping fun with a smashing cast of singers and dancers, though some note it's light on plot—perfect holiday escapism for those seeking festive cheer.
